CREATE TABLE "django_migrations" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "app" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "applied" datetime NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "auth_group_permissions" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_group" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_permission" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auth_user_groups" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "group_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_group" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auth_user_user_permissions" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_permission" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "django_admin_log" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "object_id" text NULL, "object_repr" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "action_flag" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("action_flag" >= 0), "change_message" text NOT NULL, "content_type_id" integer NULL REFERENCES "django_content_type" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "action_time" datetime NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "django_content_type" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "app_label" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "model" varchar(100) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "auth_permission" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "content_type_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "django_content_type" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "codename" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "auth_group" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE "auth_user" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "password" varchar(128) NOT NULL, "last_login" datetime NULL, "is_superuser" bool NOT NULL, "username" varchar(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "last_name" varchar(150) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL, "is_staff" bool NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "date_joined" datetime NOT NULL, "first_name" varchar(150) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "projects_project" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, slug varchar(255))

CREATE TABLE "projects_projectobligation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "obligation_id" varchar(20) NOT NULL REFERENCES "obligations_obligation" ("obligation_number") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "project_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "projects_project" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "mechanisms_environmentalmechanism" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NULL, "category" varchar(100) NULL, "reference_number" varchar(50) NULL, "effective_date" date NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "not_started_count" integer NOT NULL, "in_progress_count" integer NOT NULL, "completed_count" integer NOT NULL, "overdue_count" integer NOT NULL, "primary_environmental_mechanism" varchar(255) NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "project_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "projects_project" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)
CREATE TABLE "django_session" ("session_key" varchar(40) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "session_data" text NOT NULL, "expire_date" datetime NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "obligations_obligation" ("obligation_number" varchar(20) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "procedure" text NOT NULL, "environmental_aspect" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "obligation" text NOT NULL, "accountability" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "responsibility" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "project_phase" varchar(255) NULL, "action_due_date" date NULL, "close_out_date" date NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "supporting_information" text NULL, "general_comments" text NULL, "compliance_comments" text NULL, "non_conformance_comments" text NULL, "recurring_obligation" bool NOT NULL, "recurring_frequency" varchar(50) NULL, "recurring_status" varchar(50) NULL, "recurring_forecasted_date" date NULL, "inspection" bool NOT NULL, "inspection_frequency" varchar(50) NULL, "new_control_action_required" bool NOT NULL, "obligation_type" varchar(50) NULL, "gap_analysis" bool NOT NULL, "notes_for_gap_analysis" text NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "primary_environmental_mechanism_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "mechanisms_environmentalmechanism" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "project_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "projects_project" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "custom_environmental_aspect" varchar(255) NULL, "evidence_notes" text NULL, "site_or_desktop" varchar(10) NULL, recurring_forecasted_date DATE)

CREATE TABLE "obligations_obligationevidence" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "file" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "uploaded_at" datetime NOT NULL, "description" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "obligation_id" varchar(20) NOT NULL REFERENCES "obligations_obligation" ("obligation_number") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "projects_projectmembership" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "project_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "projects_project" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "role" varchar(50) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "account_emailconfirmation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created" datetime NOT NULL, "sent" datetime NULL, "key" varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "email_address_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "account_emailaddress" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "account_emailaddress" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "verified" bool NOT NULL, "primary" bool NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "mfa_authenticator" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "data" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("data") OR "data" IS NULL)), "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "last_used_at" datetime NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "unique_authenticator_type" ON "mfa_authenticator" ("user_id", "type") WHERE "type" IN ('totp', 'recovery_codes')

CREATE TABLE "socialaccount_socialapp" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "provider" varchar(30) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "client_id" varchar(191) NOT NULL, "secret" varchar(191) NOT NULL, "key" varchar(191) NOT NULL, "provider_id" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "settings" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("settings") OR "settings" IS NULL)))

CREATE TABLE "socialaccount_socialtoken" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "token" text NOT NULL, "token_secret" text NOT NULL, "expires_at" datetime NULL, "account_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "socialaccount_socialaccount" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "app_id" integer NULL REFERENCES "socialaccount_socialapp" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "socialaccount_socialaccount" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "provider" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "uid" varchar(191) NOT NULL, "last_login" datetime NOT NULL, "date_joined" datetime NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "extra_data" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("extra_data") OR "extra_data" IS NULL)))

CREATE TABLE "usersessions_usersession" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "ip" char(39) NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" datetime NOT NULL, "session_key" varchar(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "user_agent" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "data" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("data") OR "data" IS NULL)), "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)
CREATE TABLE "chatbot_predefinedresponse" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "trigger_phrase" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "response_text" text NOT NULL, "priority" integer NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "chatbot_trainingdata" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "question" text NOT NULL, "answer" text NOT NULL, "category" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "chatbot_conversation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "chatbot_chatmessage" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "content" text NOT NULL, "is_bot" bool NOT NULL, "timestamp" datetime NOT NULL, "attachments" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("attachments") OR "attachments" IS NULL)), "conversation_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "chatbot_conversation" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "company_companymembership" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "role" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "department" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "position" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "date_joined" datetime NOT NULL, "is_primary" bool NOT NULL, "company_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "company_company" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "company_companydocument" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "file" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "document_type" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "uploaded_at" datetime NOT NULL, "company_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "company_company" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "uploaded_by_id" integer NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "company_company" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "logo" varchar(100) NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "website" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "address" text NOT NULL, "phone" varchar(50) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL, "company_type" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "size" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "industry" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "responsibility_responsibility" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" text NOT NULL, company_id INTEGER REFERENCES company_company(id))

CREATE TABLE "feedback_bugreport" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "environment" text NOT NULL, "application_version" varchar(50) NOT NULL, "operating_system" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "browser" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "device_type" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "steps_to_reproduce" text NOT NULL, "expected_behavior" text NOT NULL, "actual_behavior" text NOT NULL, "error_messages" text NOT NULL, "trace_report" text NOT NULL, "frequency" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "impact_severity" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "user_impact" text NOT NULL, "workarounds" text NOT NULL, "additional_comments" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "github_issue_url" varchar(200) NULL, "severity" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(15) NOT NULL, "admin_comment" text NOT NULL, "created_by_id" integer NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "procedures_procedure" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "document_id" varchar(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "version" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "compliance_status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "effective_date" date NULL, "review_date" date NULL, "completed_at" datetime NULL, "document_file" varchar(100) NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "tags" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "project_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "projects_project" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE company_company_users (
                        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                        company_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES company_company(id),
                        FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES auth_user(id),
                        UNIQUE(company_id, user_id)
                    )
CREATE TABLE "auditing_audit" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "auditing_audit_mechanisms" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "audit_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "auditing_audit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "environmentalmechanism_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "mechanisms_environmentalmechanism" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auditing_auditentry" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "finding" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "audit_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "auditing_audit" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "obligation_id" varchar(20) NOT NULL REFERENCES "obligations_obligation" ("obligation_number") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auditing_compliancecomment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "text" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "obligation_id" varchar(20) NOT NULL REFERENCES "obligations_obligation" ("obligation_number") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auditing_mitigation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "description" text NOT NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "audit_entry_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "auditing_auditentry" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auditing_correctiveaction" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "task" text NOT NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "due_date" date NULL, "assigned_to_id" integer NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "mitigation_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "auditing_mitigation" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "auditing_nonconformancecomment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "text" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "obligation_id" varchar(20) NOT NULL REFERENCES "obligations_obligation" ("obligation_number") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)
CREATE TABLE "django_plotly_dash_statelessapp" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "app_name" varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "slug" varchar(110) NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE "django_plotly_dash_dashapp" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "instance_name" varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "slug" varchar(110) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "base_state" text NOT NULL, "creation" datetime NOT NULL, "update" datetime NOT NULL, "save_on_change" bool NOT NULL, "stateless_app_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "django_plotly_dash_statelessapp" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "guardian_groupobjectpermission" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "object_pk" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "content_type_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "django_content_type" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "group_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_group" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_permission" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "guardian_userobjectpermission" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "object_pk" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "content_type_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "django_content_type" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "permission_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_permission" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "user_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

CREATE TABLE "users_profile" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "bio" text NOT NULL, "position" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "department" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "phone_number" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "profile_image" varchar(100) NULL, "welcome_email_sent" bool NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "auth_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "has_completed_profile" bool NOT NULL)
